info.title: Register of Interests API
info.description: API to allow users to query and download the register of Members interests.

get.summary: Return a list of categories interests should be registered under, sorted by category number.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description:
Type of categories (commons members, commons staff list etc.) to filter by.
If not provided, all categories will be returned. Please note: this **will** include other types as they are added in the future.

parameters.name: Skip
parameters.description: The number of records to skip from the first, default is 0.

parameters.name: Take
parameters.description: The number of records to return, default is 20.

get.summary: Return details of an interest category by ID.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of the category.

get.summary: Return a list of interests that have been published.

parameters.name: RegisterId
parameters.description: Search for an interest published in a register with this ID. If not provided, returns interests in all registers.

parameters.name: InterestIds
parameters.description: List of interest ids to filter by.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description:
Type of categories (commons members, commons staff list etc.) to filter by.
If not provided, all categories will be returned. Please note: this **will** include other types as they are added in the future.

parameters.name: ExcludeExpired
parameters.description: Whether to include or exclude interests that have expired (will also apply to child interests if ExpandChildInterests is true).

parameters.name: Take
parameters.description: The number of records to return, default is 20.

parameters.name: MemberId
parameters.description: Search for an interest created by member with this ID.

parameters.name: CategoryId
parameters.description: Search for an interest within a specific category with this ID.

parameters.name: PublishedFrom
parameters.description: Search for an interest published on or after this date.

parameters.name: PublishedTo
parameters.description: Search for an interest published on or before this date.

parameters.name: RegisteredFrom
parameters.description: Search for an interest registered on or after this date.

parameters.name: RegisteredTo
parameters.description: Search for an interest registered on or before this date.

parameters.name: UpdatedFrom
parameters.description: Search for an interest which has any updates on or after this date.

parameters.name: UpdatedTo
parameters.description: Search for an interest which has any updates on or before this date.

parameters.name: ExpandChildInterests
parameters.description: If true returns related interests in a nested format, rather than as individual items.

parameters.name: SortOrder
parameters.description: The order in which to return records.

parameters.name: Skip
parameters.description: The number of records to skip from the first, default is 0.

get.summary: Return the latest version of an interest which has been published.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of the interest.

get.summary: Return interests that have been published on a register as a collection of CSVs packaged in a ZIP file

parameters.name: InterestIds
parameters.description: List of interest ids to filter by.

parameters.name: ExpandChildInterests
parameters.description: If true returns related interests together (in subsequent rows from parent interest), rather than in a separate file

parameters.name: RegisterId
parameters.description: Search for an interest published in a register with this ID. If not provided, returns interests in all registers.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description:
Type of categories (commons members, commons staff list etc.) to filter by.
If not provided, all categories will be returned. Please note: this **will** include other types as they are added in the future.

parameters.name: ExcludeExpired
parameters.description: Whether to include or exclude interests that have expired (will also apply to child interests if ExpandChildInterests is true).

parameters.name: MemberId
parameters.description: Search for an interest created by member with this ID.

parameters.name: CategoryId
parameters.description: Search for an interest with associated category with this ID.

parameters.name: PublishedFrom
parameters.description: Search for an interest published on or after this date.

parameters.name: PublishedTo
parameters.description: Search for an interest published on or before this date.

parameters.name: RegisteredFrom
parameters.description: Search for an interest registered on or after this date.

parameters.name: RegisteredTo
parameters.description: Search for an interest registered on or before this date.

parameters.name: UpdatedFrom
parameters.description: Search for an interest which has any updates on or after this date.

parameters.name: UpdatedTo
parameters.description: Search for an interest which has any updates on or before this date.

parameters.name: IncludeFieldDescriptions
parameters.description: Returns a metadata file for each category, containing a list of fields which are available for a member to add further information about the interest.

get.summary: Return a list of published versions of registers of interests.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description:
Type of register (commons members, commons staff list etc.) to filter by.
If not provided, all register will be returned. Please note: this **will** include other types as they are added in the future.

parameters.name: SessionId
parameters.description: Search for registers published within a parliamentary session with this ID. Find session data at https://whatson-api.parliament.uk/.

parameters.name: Skip
parameters.description: The number of records to skip from the first, default is 0.

parameters.name: Take
parameters.description: The number of records to return, default is 20.

get.summary: Return a published version of a register of interests by ID.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of the register.

get.summary: Return a published register as a PDF document by ID.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of the register.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Whether to return a document containing the full register or only updates. Default value is Full.

InterestsSortOrder.description: The order in which interests endpoints should return results.

rel.description: Relationship of the link to the object requested.

href.description: A complete URL that shows how the action can be performed.

Link.description: HATEOAS Link for retrieving related information to a response or object.

nameDisplayAs.description: Member's current full name, as it should be displayed in text.

nameListAs.description: Member's current name in the format {surname}, {forename}, for use in an ordered list.

house.description: The name of the House the Member is currently associated with.

memberFrom.description: How they are a Member of Parliament (for MP, this is their constituency)

party.description: Party the Member is currently associated with.

links.description: A list of HATEOAS Links for retrieving further information about this member.

Member.description: Member of Parliament who has registered the interest.

jobTitle.description: Job title the staff member holds for the member.

MemberStaffEmployment.description: Information about the member a staff member works for, and their job title for that member.

identifier.description: Unique identifier for the staff on a per-request basis to enable correlation of interest within same request where member has multiple staff with same job title.

employment.description:
List of members the staff works for, and their job title per member.
Please note: not all interests declared by the staff will be relevant for all of their members. Refer to relevant field for that information.

MemberStaffInfo.description: Information for the staff member who has registered the interest

number.description: Number of the category in the code of conduct.

parentCategoryIds.description: The unique ID for any parent category to which this category is associated, if the category is associated with another category.

links.description: A list of HATEOAS Links for retrieving further information about this category.

PublishedCategory.description: Category an interest can be registered with.

skip.description: The skip value that was used in the query.

take.description: The take value that was used in the query.

totalResults.description: The total number of results which matches the query.

items.description: The list of items found for the specified page (by requested skip and take).

links.description: A list of HATEOAS Links for navigating through the paginated result.

PublishedCategoryApiLinkedSearchResult.description: Paginated search result with HATEOAS Links.

parentInterestId.description: The unique ID for the payer (parent interest) to which this payment (child interest) is associated.

childInterests.description: List of Interests which are sub interests of this interest. Only populated when `ExpandChildInterests` is true or when retrieving a single interest by ID; otherwise this is an empty list.

versions.description: List of versions the interest has appeared in a register under

links.description: A list of HATEOAS Links for retrieving related information about this interest.

PublishedInterest.description: Representation of a interest that has been published

skip.description: The skip value that was used in the query.

take.description: The take value that was used in the query.

totalResults.description: The total number of results which matches the query.

items.description: The list of items found for the specified page (by requested skip and take).

links.description: A list of HATEOAS Links for navigating through the paginated result.

PublishedInterestApiLinkedSearchResult.description: Paginated search result with HATEOAS Links.

summary.description: Title Summary for the interest as at this publication.

registrationDate.description: Registration Date on the published interest as at this publication.

publishedDate.description: Date when this version of interest was first published.

updatedDates.description: A list of dates on which this version of interest was updated since it has been published.

rectified.description: Whether the version has been rectified (e.g. when the interest was submitted late).

rectifiedDetails.description: The reason that the version was rectified, or `null` if this version was not rectified.

fields.description: List of fields which are available for a member to add further information about this version.

displayInformation.description: Display information for rendering this version in members web.

links.description: A list of HATEOAS Links for retrieving related information about this version.

publishedDate.description: Date when the Register was published.

links.description: A list of HATEOAS Links for retrieving related information about this register.

PublishedRegister.description: A published version of a register of interests.

skip.description: The skip value that was used in the query.

take.description: The take value that was used in the query.

totalResults.description: The total number of results which matches the query.

items.description: The list of items found for the specified page (by requested skip and take).

links.description: A list of HATEOAS Links for navigating through the paginated result.

PublishedRegisterApiLinkedSearchResult.description: Paginated search result with HATEOAS Links.

RegisterDocument.description: Whether a document contains the full register or only updates

RegisterType.description: The type of register of interests

Registrant.description: Person who has registered the interest

RegistrantType.description:
Type of the person who has registered the interest
More options may be added in the future.
